thread:
Casey Moore: Kicking off VeraLogix onboarding thread. Need to lock stakeholders, pick deployment (Hosted/Private/on-prem), agree success metrics for a 30-day POC, and sketch a compact timeline. Proposed kickoff Tue 4/20 9:00am PT, 30m. Agenda: owners, SSO/network, data scope, POC success gates.

Jules Park (VeraLogix): Tue 9 works. We require Private w/ optional on-prem connector. Compliance: SOC2 + ISO27001 in scope. We'll seed ~50k docs (mix of KB + product specs). Want POC within 30 days.

Rafael Ortiz: Noted. For Private+on-prem we'll need network allowlist and egress rules. Jules, can you confirm whether the on-prem connector can open outbound 443 to our ingestion host?

Jules Park (VeraLogix): Yes, outbound 443 allowed. We'll provide proxy details. SSO: OIDC via Azure AD. I'll share app metadata + admin contact.

Leah Grant: I'll run enablement and the pilot workshop. Plan: 90-min workshop week2, eval pack for regression checks, and quick UX checklist.

Casey Moore: Draft owners: VeraLogix exec sponsor: Jules Park; VeraLogix infra: TBA (Jules to confirm); Redwood CSM: Casey Moore; Redwood Solutions: Leah Grant; Redwood Infra: Rafael Ortiz.

Casey Moore: Proposed POC success criteria (edit as needed):
- Authenticated endpoint reachable from VeraLogix network (OIDC)
- 50k docs ingested and basic index searchable within 72h
- p95 latency < 200ms under pilot load in staging
- Pilot satisfaction >= 4/5 from target users after week 2

Jules Park (VeraLogix): Add compliance gating: legal sign-off on PHI/PCI scoping before go/no-go.

Rafael Ortiz: Capacity note: we'll reserve a small Dedicated pool for days 0-30 and allow burst to Hosted if needed. Need sample QPS to finalize numbers.

Casey Moore: Early blockers to track: legal/compliance review, network allowlist + proxy details, sample data delivery and cleanup. Renewal signal: strong POC engagement + satisfaction; if either low we'll trigger an exec review at day 25.

Jules Park (VeraLogix): We'll upload 5k sample docs and proxy details by Mon EOD. Legal will start compliance checklist review this week.

Rafael Ortiz: Firewall snippet for infra team to test:
```
# allow outbound to redwood ingestion
allow tcp 443 -> 10.20.0.0/16
allow tcp 8443 -> 10.20.0.12
```

Leah Grant: I'll post the week0-4 owner timeline and attach the eval pack link before the kickoff.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "VeraLogix POC Kickoff" Tue Apr 20 9:00am PT  invite sent to Jules, Casey, Rafael, Leah. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/meet/veralogix-poc-0420

Casey Moore: Thanks everyone  will drop a compact 0-30 owner table here by EOD. Please flag any scheduling conflicts.

Jules Park (VeraLogix): Thanks all, looking forward to it. :thumbsup:
